0022600005.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons as the Lakers host the Golden State Warriors. The Lakers will be without Adou Thiero (knee) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain), and Collin Sexton is day-to-day with a calf injury and a game-time decision, while the Warriors are missing Brandin Podziemski (back soreness), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (undisclosed) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), with Charles Bassey (knee) and Stephen Curry (ankle sprain) also day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Lakers won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 119-103 regular-season win in San Francisco on April 9, 2026, the most recent meeting between them.
